test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 7 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: If a cube of 15 cm side is divided into smaller cubes of 3 cm side, then how many smaller cubes will be formed?
solution:
**Given:**

Side of the large cube = 15 cm

Side of the smaller cube = 3 cm

**Formula Used:**

Number of smaller cubes = (Side of the large cube / Side of the smaller cube)³

**Calculation:**

Number of smaller cubes = (15 / 3)³

⇒ Number of smaller cubes = 5³

⇒ Number of smaller cubes = 125

**The number of smaller cubes formed is 125.**
